deadline.value: Cal State Apply is due December 1, and the department's supplemental application is due December 15.
deadline.quote: Step 1: Complete the CSU Cal State Apply Application by December 1

gre_general.value: General GRE scores have been suspended, so neither biology PhD requires them.
gre_general.quote: General GRE test scores have been suspended and are NOT required.

also.quote: Note: GRE Scores are not required.

gre_subject.value: Biology has no GRE Subject test, and the pages do not mention one.

ielts_min.value: The Cell and Molecular Biology page sets IELTS at 7.0 overall, higher than the university's 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS overall score of 7.0 or higher

supervisor.value: The Evolutionary Biology page asks applicants to name an SDSU faculty advisor and encourages contacting faculty first. The Cell and Molecular page does not say.
supervisor.quote: You are encouraged to contact potential faculty advisors in advance of submitting your application

funding.value: The biology application pages do not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: The biology application pages do not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: Covers two joint PhDs run by the SDSU Biology department: Cell and Molecular Biology (with UC San Diego, page above) and Evolutionary Biology (with UC Riverside, https://biology.sdsu.edu/doctoral/evolutionary/application-procedures/). The IELTS 7.0 rule is from the Cell and Molecular page; the Evolutionary page does not restate it. The department page says SDSU does not waive the Cal State Apply fee, which is consistent with the university record. Ecology is a separate record under environment.
name: Cell and Molecular Biology; Evolutionary Biology (joint PhDs)
